Export Your Research Figure

Asset author and license information is preserved with SVG and project files.

From Assets to Figures in a Few Steps

  1. Add Assets

    Search by English or Chinese name, click or drag onto canvas. You can also import your own SVG files.

  2. Arrange & Annotate

    Drag icons to position, drag the corner handle to resize. Edit labels, dimensions, and colors in the right panel.

  3. Connect Steps

    Select "Connect", then click the start and target elements. Connectors automatically track moved elements.

  4. Save & Export

    Autosave is local to this browser. Download project files to back up your work, or export SVG, PNG, or draw.io for other tools.

V Select · C Connect · T Text · Delete Remove

Templates are starting points. Please modify steps and conditions according to your actual experimental protocol.
